quotes.name: Omar Lingio
quotes.quote: You know, it's moments like those that remind me why I love Temescal so much. I was just standing there, watching the fog roll in, and it felt like the whole neighborhood was wrapped in this quiet, peaceful blanket. I felt grateful to be a part of this community, to have my store here and be able to experience days like that.
